comment: E22-F2 shadow order route on Alpaca PAPER (forward/orders_alpaca.py). Off by default. A shadow record only: E22-F2's verdict is its paper book. ledger_path must never be the E22-F2 ledger (refused). mode: moc_whole (market-on-close, whole shares; facts A5, A8) or fractional_day (fractional longs, day orders that fill near the next open). closed_dates: exchange-closed weekdays (YYYY-MM-DD) used to find the next session.
